task.title: Step 01: ISSUE-FIXER root cause diagnosis for GH-765/ISS-0700
task.description: Diagnose why iss205_webhook_outbox_test.zig TC1/TC2/TC3 fail with PoolError.QueryFailed. Read the test file, the webhook + outbox source files, and the migrations affecting webhook_subscriptions and webhook_deliveries. Run the test in isolation to capture the exact error. Identify the schema mismatch (missing column, FK constraint, missing table) and the migration that introduced the discrepancy. Produce a diagnosis report.

context.known_context: TC1 seeds a webhook_subscriptions row and a users row before testing outbox insert + rollback atomicity. QueryFailed on first transaction insert suggests a schema mismatch. PAR-01 (migration 1147) also changed webhook_deliveries — see memories/repo/bpm-gh764-par01-idempotency-schema-shift.md (PAR-01 added/deleted columns on webhook_deliveries which were restored by migration 1155 per GH-763). Verify that 1155's restore is in place AND covers all columns the test references.

verification.test_repro_captured: YES — captured live run twice on main HEAD 93bfeb97; both runs end with 'All 3 tests passed' (full log: scratch/gh765_final_test.log).
verification.root_cause_identified: GH-765 is a stale-evidence duplicate of GH-763. PAR-01 (migration 1147, commit 38cb7967, 2026-08-11) dropped seven webhook_deliveries columns (event_type, instance_id, payload_json, trace_id, delivered_at, last_http_status, last_error) that 023_ext02_webhook_event_dispatch.sql had added. Migration 1155 (commit eec9edc3, PR #771, 2026-08-13 11:57 UTC) restored them idempotently under every tenant schema. GH-765 was opened at 2026-08-13T09:33:02Z — one minute after GH-763 — and captured the failure in the 2h25m window before the fix landed. The same report later claimed identical failure on main before GH-760's commit 1e4f31f1; that anomaly predates 1155 as well.
verification.responsible_migration_sha: 38cb7967 (PAR-01, introduced drift; FIXED by eec9edc3 / migration 1155, already on main HEAD 93bfeb97).
verification.responsible_source_sha: n/a — no source file is at fault. The fix is migration-only.

result.summary: GH-765 / ISS-0700 is a stale-evidence duplicate of GH-763. PAR-01 migration 1147 (commit 38cb7967) dropped seven webhook_deliveries columns (event_type, instance_id, payload_json, trace_id, delivered_at, last_http_status, last_error); migration 1155 (commit eec9edc3, PR #771, merged 2026-08-13 11:57 UTC) restored them. iss205_webhook_outbox_test.zig passes 3/3 on main HEAD 93bfeb97 with the fix in place. No code/migration change required. Recommend closing GH-765 as duplicate of GH-763 and letting DOC-UPDATER run Step 7 + Step Final only (pipeline collapse, same pattern as WF03-GH758-20260813).
